findings.evidence: The proof only uses `ν.val.contMDiff`, `hom_trivializationAt_baseSet`, `TangentBundle.trivializationAt_baseSet` and `inCoordinates_pullback_of_mem` with `ContMDiffMap.fst`/`snd`, all of which work for any `IP`/`P`. `DomainDependentHomSection` (`Inhomogeneous/Basic.lean:49`) is defined for any `IP`, `P`. The `omit [I.Boundaryless]` already shows the section context is mostly unused.
findings.fix: State `DomainDependentHomSection.contMDiffOn_inCoordinates (σ : DomainDependentHomSection I M IP P n) (x : P) (y : M)` on `(chartAt HP x).source ×ˢ (chartAt H y).source` with model `IP.prod I` and fibre `EP →L[ℝ] E`, in `Inhomogeneous/Basic.lean`. Then get the current statement by applying it to `ν.val`.
findings.issue: `InhomogeneousTerm.contMDiffOn_inCoordinates` only uses `ν.val : DomainDependentHomSection I M 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) Y n`. It never uses `jY`, `JY` or the fact that `Y` is modelled on `ℂ`, so it is stated more narrowly than its proof needs.

findings.evidence: `Family/Chart.lean:96`: `theorem contDiffOn_inChart [IsManifold IP n P] (J : ContMDiffAlmostComplexStructureFamily I M IP P n) (q : P × M)` needs only `n`.
findings.fix: Take `[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) n Y]` and delete the `have : IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) n Y := .of_le …` step.
findings.issue: `contDiffOn_chartField_chartAt` assumes `[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ Y]` and then lowers it to `n` with `.of_le`. This is stronger than the lemma it relies on requires.

summary: Two new chart lemmas are stated more narrowly than their proofs need: `contMDiffOn_inCoordinates` holds for any domain-dependent Hom section over any domain, not just an inhomogeneous term over a Riemann surface, and `contDiffOn_chartField_chartAt` assumes a smooth (`∞`) manifold structure on `Y` where `n` is enough.
